key_insight: The paper shows that mangrove wave attenuation depends strongly on vertical biomass distribution and root characteristics, so a generalized vegetation profile is needed to model drag realistically.
engineering_relevance: It provides a simplified mangrove representation that can be used in CFD and experimental setups to design and assess nature-based coastal protection systems more accurately.
method: Generalized mangrove vegetation profile across species
Derived a wave attenuation model that explicitly includes root characteristics
Built a simplified drag-matching representation for CFD and fabrication
evidence_signal: The proposed model was evaluated in OpenFOAM simulations, showing frequency-selective and species-dependent wave attenuation behavior.
watch_item: The simplified model may be less reliable if local root geometry or species-specific biomass profiles are poorly characterized.
paper_title: On the Modelling of the Hydrodynamic Drag of Mangroves
